_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); chemical and refining signals

pit_profile.why: Risk factor (FY2012 10-K): Our businesses’ results are impacted by seasonal effects and are highly cyclical.; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing': none names chemicals or refining, and no 10-K names cloud or offshore delivery), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: Risk factor (FY2012 10-K): Our businesses’ results are impacted by seasonal effects and are highly cyclical.; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing': none names chemicals or refining, and no 10-K names cloud or offshore delivery), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule). cyclical (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 6.85x; +101% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.92; conservative 2yr -28%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY11-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -0.0%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 2.2-yr ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +14.8%/yr (FY11-FY12 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +14.8%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY11-FY12: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LYB (retrospective, 2013-03-01) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 6.85x (38.0% downside to Bear $37 / +5.5% upside to Bull $63) | Adj composite 1.85 vs market 3.77: gap -1.92 [OVERVALUED] | +101% above the EPP floor $30 (6x FY13E $4.96) | Conservative 2-yr case: -28.0% total (-14.0%/yr) | At 12.0x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $79 sits above the BULL case; O&P–Americas +111.3% and Intermediates & Derivatives +33.0% operating income in Q4 2012, forward revenues +1.1% (no FY13 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2012 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date; none has dated evidence.
